title: Acquisition intracommunautaire de biens (autoliquidation 21%)
description: Reverse-charge VAT on intra-EU acquisition of goods. The base is reported in both 86 (intra-EU acquisitions, informational) and 81 (raw materials/merchandise). The autoliquidated VAT hits both 55 (tax due) and 59 (tax deductible) when the acquisition is fully deductible.
name: be_vat_intra_eu_acquisition_goods

title: Services intracommunautaires reçus B2B (autoliquidation 21%)

title: Livraisons intracommunautaires (exemptées art. 39bis)

title: Exportations hors UE (exemptées art. 39)
description: Exempt sales of goods exported outside the EU.
